founderIntent: Build a source-owned synthetic SaaS that helps mid-sized companies understand and reduce Snowflake spend.
problemStatement: Data teams often lack a simple, explainable way to identify major Snowflake cost drivers and prioritize optimization work.
targetCustomer: Mid-sized companies using Snowflake with a small data platform team and meaningful recurring warehouse spend.
valueProposition: Provide a safe synthetic demonstration of cost-driver analysis, prioritization, and evidence-backed optimization recommendations without connecting to a production warehouse.
businessModelHypothesis: Subscription SaaS with a free synthetic/demo tier and a future paid team tier; Phase A does not validate pricing demand.
productForm: Web application with synthetic Snowflake usage/cost fixtures, dashboards, findings, and recommendation evidence.
launchConstraints: Phase A uses synthetic data only
No real customer or prospect data
No real email or social publishing
No legal filing or payment/card use
geographyAssumptions: United States market hypothesis for research only; no incorporation action in Phase A
